programme.title: 誰是兇手 第5集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: 錯在新宿
programme.desc: 小男人阿寬與妻Ann復合後, 互相遷就, 再婚生活逐漸愜意。寬進公關公司任職, 認識了缺乏自信的女同事關之琳。見她終日冒冒失失, 更被追求不遂者捉挾, 寬於心不忍, 在工作上處處扶持。正因如此, 關對寬由同事之誼轉為男女之情, 剛好寬與Ann稍有磨擦, 寬轉而愛上了關, 更與關去日本公幹。此時, Ann遇上區議員朱君, 對朱頗有好感, 但Ann懸崖勒馬, 沒有動真情。返港後, 寬欲向Ann攤牌, 關竟搶著表示與寬只屬工作關係, 請Ann放心。關毅然斷絕與寬的感情關係, 令寬遭受打擊, 心情頹然。Ann得悉真相, 與寬決裂, 幾經糾纏、掙扎、衝突, 兩人竟又復合, 展開了另一段再婚又再婚的新婚生活。

programme.title: 虎度門
programme.desc: 粵劇名伶冷劍心為了把粵劇現代化, 請來林導演加入百老匯元素, 受到保守派排斥。另一方面, 劍心的丈夫決定移民, 劍心和女兒珊珊反對, 而女兒又被懷疑有同性戀傾向, 家人關係更加惡化。此時劍心在廿二年前於南洋誕下的私生子竟然出現眼前, 還跟劇團新進花旦葉玉媚相戀......

programme.title: 英雄好漢
programme.desc: 李阿擠是潮州大阿哥, 但他已經事業有成有妻有子, 開始討厭鎗林彈雨的生活；擠哥曾有兩名手下鄧家勇與陳定國, 定國是家勇父親吉叔養子, 二人本來情同手足, 但芋次事件中, 家勇與擠哥反目而定國隨即遠走馬六甲。擠哥與家勇大哥朱老大是生意上的拍擋, 朱老大以家勇逐漸失去控制, 想除去家勇卻反被家勇所殺。擠哥意圖與家勇和談反為所辱。家勇更進而調戲擠哥妻子, 定國得悉後從馬六甲趕回代擠哥向家勇求情, 家勇允之...

programme.title: 決戰紫禁之巔
programme.desc: 大內密探龍龍九奉命追捕鬼王七盜, 發現他是武當掌門凌雲鶴之化身, 在途中結識劍神西門吹雪。西門吹雪救了葉子青而相戀, 劍聖葉孤城向西門吹雪挑戰, 於九月十五日紫禁之巔比劍, 爭奪世上劍法第一, 御妹金燕子傾慕葉孤城, 欲阻止是次比劍。當中龍龍九識破此乃是刺殺皇上之陰謀...

programme.title: BEYOND日記之莫欺少年窮
programme.desc: 四個高中畢業、熱愛音樂青年, 各為自己目標奮鬥的故事。阿駒是一個為移民而與家人瘋狂搵錢的青年, 最後儲錢目標達到, 但因體力透支而病倒；阿強是一個有衝勁而頗有頭腦的青年人, 立志要創一番事業, 可惜誤入一間金融公司工作, 在上司設計之下連番受挫折, 最後連至親亦受牽連；阿中自小立志加入紀律部隊服務大眾, 但因身體潺弱, 未獲警隊接納, 索性加入交通督導員行列, 但因職責特殊, 對內對外均受極大壓力而深感痛苦；阿榮是一個勤奮而內向的學生, 一心入讀大學音樂系, 但在女友之父親諸多阻撓之下, 終於選讀入醫科...

programme.title: 行運超人
programme.desc: 葉孤紅做事頭頭碰著黑, 從小到大無人問津, 幸好孤紅個性開朗, 對一切噩運也一笑置之。孤紅將大部份時間寄託於各種風水, 卻無助於自己的霉運。在命運驅使上, 孤紅遇上著名風水術數家賴料布, 而這段姻緣還可化解孤紅一直以來厄運, 豈料橫裡殺出另一個堪輿高手斷蟹從中作梗...

programme.title: Sauvage, rusé et mortel
programme.desc: Dans l'eau, les airs, sur ou sous terre, les animaux déploient des trésors d'ingéniosité pour survivre, repousser les prédateurs, trouver de la nourriture ou se reproduire afin de perpétuer leurs espèce.

programme.title: Les zarbis
programme.desc: A la découverte des animaux les plus étonnants, extravagants et bizarres que comprend le règne animal. Abeilles, girafes ou encore diable de Tasmanie, mettent en oeuvre des tactiques atypiques pour chasser, survivre et asseoir leur domination.

programme.title: Les zarbis
programme.desc: A la découverte des animaux les plus étonnants, extravagants et bizarres que comprend le règne animal. Pour certains d'entre eux, se reproduire est un acte étrange. Alors que certains doivent changer de sexe, chez d'autres c'est le mâle qui donne naissance à sa progéniture.

programme.title: OceanXplorers
programme.desc: Près de 80% des océans sont encore totalement méconnus. Fort de constat, l'OceanXplorer, un navire scientifique dernier cri avec à son bord des experts de renom, part à leur découverte. De l'Atlantique des Açores à la mer des Caraïbes jusqu'au rives arctiques de la Norvège, la faune et la flore marines sont présentées sous un angle inédit.

programme.title: Champion de la survie
programme.desc: Phil Breslin se rapproche des créatures les plus uniques au monde pour révéler les ultimes survivants des habitats les plus extrêmes d'Australie.

programme.title: Une saison au zoo
programme.desc: Ils sont soigneurs animaliers, vétérinaires, responsables d'hébergements, commerciaux ou encore jardiniers. Ils s'appellent Aurélie, Geoffrey ou encore Cyril. Ils ont entre 20 et 30 ans... et ils forment une véritable famille. Ce sont les employés du parc zoologique de la Flèche. Une "Saison au Zoo" existe depuis 11 saisons et fait le succès de France Télévisions.

programme.title: Merveilles du Pacifique

programme.title: Planète Hostile
programme.desc: Planète hostile s'intéresse aux cas les plus extraordinaires, presque surnaturels, d'animaux qui se sont adaptés aux plus cruels des imprévus de l'évolution. Présenté par le survivaliste et aventurier Bear Grylls, Planète hostile visite les environnements les plus extrêmes au monde et révèle des histoires épiques de survie dans le royaume animal, sur cette planète en constante et rapide évolution.

programme.title: Jurassic CSI
programme.desc: Le paléontologue Phil Manning explore les mystères de l'intelligence du Tyrannosaurus Rex. Si les fossiles témoignent de la puissance de ce géant du Crétacé, ses capacités cérébrales restent méconnues. A travers l'étude minutieuse du crâne fossilisé, Manning analyse les secrets de son cerveau, des recherches qui pourraient révolutionner nos connaissances sur cette espèce préhistorique.

programme.title: Jurassic CSI
programme.desc: Phil Manning se fixe une mission : marcher dans les pas des dinosaures pour mieux comprendre la manière dont ils se déplaçaient et couraient.

programme.title: Jurassic CSI
programme.desc: Le paléontologue Phil Manning remet en question les théories sur les dinosaures en associant paléontologie, médecine et ingénierie. Avec son équipe, il étudie les capacités sensorielles du Tyrannosaure Rex grâce aux technologies d'analyse modernes. Leurs recherches internationales permettent de rassembler progressivement les indices anatomiques et comportementaux de ces prédateurs préhistoriques.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Coming of the Treasure Ship! LuffytaroReturns the Favor!
programme.desc: Zoro and the others dash out of BakuraTown on the treasure ship filled with food! Luffy catches up to them bringing ahuge bucket of fresh water! Then, they distribute the food and the water to thepeople of Okobore Town who were thirsty and hungry.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Mysterious Grave Markers! A Reunion at the Ruins of Oden Castle!
programme.desc: Luffy arrives at the ruins of Oden Castle following Law and finds the graves of his friends, Kin'emon and the others. As Law starts telling the already-stunned Luffy about the creepy story of Kin'emon's ghost, Luffy sees it coming towards him!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Legendary Samurai! The Man Who Roger Admired!
programme.desc: Kin'emon tells Luffy and the others about how Kozuki Oden made Kuri into a peaceful region and became its Daimyo. However, he was set up by Kaido and Kurozumi Orochi and executed.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Bringing Down the Emperor of the Sea! A Secret Raid Operation Begins!
programme.desc: Kin'emon and the others crossed through time by the power of Kozuki Toki, Momonosuke's mother, and arrived at the Land of Wano 20 years later, a totally different country before their eyes.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Strongest Man in the World! Shutenmaru, the Thieves Brigade Chief!
programme.desc: Ashura Doji, one of the allies Kin'emon wants to search for, has become the head of a thieves brigade and they now raid Okobore Town taking away the food that Luffy gave to the people.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Everyone is Annihilated! Kaido's Furious Blast Breath!
programme.desc: The drunken Kaido flies above Okobore Town in his dragon form and threatens Shutenmaru and all the people in the town. Luffy, Law, Kin'emon, and Okiku start running towards the town to rescue them.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Finally Clashing! The Ferocious Luffy vs. Kaido!
programme.desc: After Luffy sees Kaido shattering the ruins of Oden Castle where he left his friends, he becomes enraged and attacks Kaido! Soon after, he finds out Kaido even assaulted Otama who was riding on Speed's back to her home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer more closely and with evermore fidelity at nearby stars, they are discovering countless exo planets. How many Earth-like planets are out there? Could one of them hold life not so different from our own?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us ... for the moment.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: They key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient skywatchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: When it comes to the birth of the universe, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the Big Bang.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one of Earth's closest neighbors, but until very recent exploratory missions, it eluded astronomers' best efforts to learn its secrets.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Il commissario Montalbano
programme.desc: Un vecchio capomastro viene ucciso, investito da un'auto. Il Commissario inizia a indagare sulla scarcerazione di un imprenditore edile, scarcerato poche settimane prima. Nel frattempo uno straniero viene trovato ucciso da un colpo di pistola. Montalbano inizia a indagare sui due casi contemporaneamente, convinto che siano collegati dallo stesso filo.

programme.title: Belcanto
programme.desc: Maria e le sue figlie, Antonia e Carolina, lasciano Napoli per sfuggire dal violento marito e inseguire il sogno del canto a Milano. Nel mondo dorato e spietato dell'Opera di metà 800, affrontano inganni, tradimenti e passioni travolgenti.

programme.title: La strada di casa
programme.desc: Fausto non crede che il figlio sia un assassino e si convince che la scomparsa di Irene sia legata a quella di un bambino ospite di una casa famiglia. Fausto scopre un sabotaggio. Gloria teme di essere affetta da Alzheimer.

programme.desc: Quando Enrico viene licenziato a causa dei suoi metodi poco ortodossi, Titti prende le sue difese. Carlo si autoproclama difensore di Persichetti, un compagno di classe affetto dai pidocchi.

programme.desc: Gina accidentally broke Felicia's house, leaving Felicia homeless. programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Thunderbell is sad because he's discovered a new fruit and eaten all of it. Now there's none left and he'll never be able to eat that fruit again. Rainbow Ruby uses a microscope to find a bacterium inside the cheesecake Thunderbell had but Felicia accidentally casts a spell that makes the bacterium gigantic.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Ling Ling takes Rainbow Ruby to Ellie's cabin where she meets mischievous baby stars that fell from the sky. The friends try to glue the broken pieces together but it doesn't work. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a jewelry designer and tries designing jewelry with the broken pieces.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Ruby's Ranger Adventure // The Show Must Go On
programme.desc: When Ruby and Choco arrive at the village, they find a very worried looking Ling Ling. Gina, Ellie, and Thunderbell went camping in Rainbow Forest but they saw a monster in the forest, got scared and had to run away. // Ruby is struggling to make a doll with her dad. Ruby and Choco get their suitcase and as Ruby swings her umbrella, there they are, in front of Rainbow fountain. Mayor Ling Ling tells her that today is the day of Princess Kiki's ballet performance.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Ruby is looking at shoes that are now too small for her but she is unwilling to throw away. Ling Ling is worried about Thunderbell. His scooter broke so he is not able to carry out his work as a mail carrier. // Gina calls Rainbow Ruby because today is the day to show their appreciation to Mayor Ling Ling. It took a long time for the village friends to prepare an amazing painting for the mayor. Unfortunately, Thunderbell accidentally destroyed the painting while delivering it.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: At Your Service // A Hard Rain
programme.desc: There is a new menu at the restaurant, which is very popular. There is a long line in front of the restaurant but there weren't enough staff members to serve the villagers the food. Rainbow Ruby turns into a waitress using her magic suitcase and serve tables kindly. // Rainbow Village is full of marbles. The marbles that Rainbow Ruby spilled in her room poured down into the village from up above the sky! Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to transform into a paramedic.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Gina, Thunderbell, and Choco try to cheer Jessy up but their efforts are of no use. While talking to Mayor Ling Ling, Rainbow Ruby realizes that today is the day that Jessy first arrived in Rainbow Village! Jessy was upset that her friends forgot such a meaningful day to her. // Ling Ling has caught a bad cold and was sneezing all over the place. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase and transforms into a doctor and cares for him.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Behind the Scenes // Paperdoll in Peril
programme.desc: Ling Ling is worried about the play planned for tonight. There are no costumes ready for the villagers so it's hard to figure out which roles they're playing. Rainbow Ruby transforms into a costume designer and designs costumes for her friends. // It is very windy in Rainbow village and Paige, a paper doll, is flying to wherever the wind takes her. She is so light that she is blown away by the wind. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a fire fighter and rescue Paige.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Singing in the Rain // Mail Carrier Mayhem
programme.desc: Ling Ling is worried that the villagers are all in low spirits. Ruby thinks of fun games to play but the villagers say that they have already played all of the games too many times. Rainbow Ruby transforms into a singer. // Ling Ling is worried because of the "Secret Present Swapping Party" that Thunderbell is preparing. Thunderbell forgot to send out the invitations. Rainbow Ruby turns into a mail carrier and delivers the invitations.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Going Golfing // Case of the Stolen Spectacles
programme.desc: Ling Ling tells Rainbow Ruby that a Rainbow Ball Tournament is about to start soon but he is worried because the field is covered with pokey pods. Thunderbell, Ellie, and Gina are trying to pick them up and clear the field but it is not easy since the pokey pods are so spikey. // Ling Ling tells Rainbow Ruby that he lost his glasses. Then Ellie tells her she lost her needles, Gina her hat, and Thunderbell his wheels. Who could have taken away all these things?

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Up in the Air // AdDRESSing the Problem
programme.desc: Ling Ling is waiting for Rainbow Ruby, looking worried. It turns out that Mr. Sloth's best friend Chirpee is depressed. Chirpee wants to fly high but is struggling due to his small wings and lack of means to learn how to fly. // Ling Ling tells Rainbow Ruby that the dress that the paper doll Paige was planning to wear to Kiki's dance party is torn. Paige very much wants to go to the party but she cannot go without a dress.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: In Rainbow Village, people are busy preparing for a dance marathon, a competition in which all of the villagers participate. Ling Ling is very sad that Ellie decided not to participate. Ellie is not a confident dancer so she doesn't want to participate. // Rainbow Ruby's friends tell her that they are now friends with Felicia. They were playing hide and seek but Felicia is such a good hider that she's refused to come out even though she's won the game.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Kiki wants to become a movie actress but the villagers have no idea how to direct a movie. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to turn into a movie director. programme.title: Cerys Matthews a'r Goeden Faled
programme.desc: Bydd Cerys Matthews yn mynd ar drywydd dwy o ganeuon gwerin mwyaf adnabyddus Cymru - Dafydd y Garreg Wen, ac Y Mochyn Du. Cerys Matthews traces the history of two more Welsh folk songs.

programme.title: Cerys Matthews: Y Goeden Faled
programme.desc: Bydd Cerys yn troi ei sylw at Bachgen Bach o Dincar, cyn teithio i Gaernarfon i ddysgu am Llwyn Onn. Cerys Matthews looks into the history of the songs Bachgen Bach o Dincar and Llwyn Onn.

programme.title: Y Fets
programme.desc: Cyfres newydd. Tro hwn: trio achub coes ci defaid un o chwaraewyr rygbi Cymru, a thrin buwch a mul styfnig ar ffermydd lleol. New series. Terry the ferret and other animals need treatment.

programme.title: Stori'r Iaith - Cerys Matthews
programme.desc: Cyfres newydd. Cerys Matthews sy'n mynd ar daith bersonol i olrhain stori'r iaith Gymraeg. A new series. Cerys Matthews goes on a personal journey exploring the story of the Welsh language.

programme.title: Llond Bol o Japan
programme.desc: Mae Chris Flamebaster Roberts yn Japan lle mae'n cwrdd â meistr swshi ac yn ymweld â marchnad byd enwog Nishiki yn Kyoto. Chris Flamebaster is in Japan, ready to set his tastebuds ablaze!

programme.title: Trefi Gwyllt Iolo
programme.desc: Mae Iolo'n gweld llwynogod, moch daear a dyfrgwn yn crwydro yn y nos. Iolo sees foxes, badgers and otters roaming in the night and visits Wrexham, Haverfordwest, Carmarthen and Pembroke.

programme.title: Cyfrinachau'r Great Escape
programme.desc: Stori peilot o'r Ail Ryfel Byd sy'n datgelu gwybodaeth newydd am y ffilm 'The Great Escape'. The story of a pilot from WWII, which reveals new information about the film 'The Great Escape'.

programme.title: Ffermio
programme.desc: Pwysigrwydd cymorth cyntaf i ffermwyr a dau frawd sydd wedi dod i'r brig gyda'u buches godro. The importance of first aid for farmers and two brothers who have won with their dairy herd.

programme.title: New: Pobol y Cwm Omnibws
programme.desc: Cipolwg yn ôl dros ddigwyddiadau'r wythnos yng Nghwmderi. Omnibus edition looking back at the events in Cwmderi over the past week. With on-screen English subtitles.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C
programme.desc: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd. S4C News and Weather.

programme.title: New: Dechrau Canu Dechrau Canmol
programme.desc: Lowri Morgan sydd yn Nheml Shree Swaminarayan yng Nghaerdydd yn profi llawenydd Gwyl Diwali. Lowri Morgan is in Shree Swaminarayan Temple in Cardiff experiencing the joy of Diwali Festival.

programme.title: New: Cyrraedd Cymru
programme.desc: Seren sy'n olrhain hanesion pobl Asiaidd yng Nghymru, o feddygon i ffoaduriaid, a'u hetifeddiaeth. Seren explores Asian stories in Wales, from doctors to refugees, and their lasting legacy.

programme.title: Glyndwr: Gobaith a Gwaed
programme.desc: Drama-ddogfen emosiynol am Glyndwr, o frwydro Coron Lloegr i'w ddiflaniad dirgel. Emotional docudrama about Glyndwr, from his rebellion against the English to his mysterious disappearance.

programme.title: Prosiect Pum Mil
programme.desc: Mae'r criw yn nhref Rhydaman yr wythnos hon i helpu cangen Derwen Newydd o elusen y Wallich. The gang are in Ammanford this week to help the Derwen Newydd branch of the Wallich charity.

programme.title: Y Ci Perffaith
programme.desc: Y tro ma, mae'r teulu Evans yn cael cwmni dau gi - un bach ac un mwy mewn maint. Ond pa un fydd eu Ci Perffaith? Today, the Evans family are joined by two dogs, one small and one larger.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae Cadi Ceffylau a Cai Caffi'n mwynhau diwrnod i ffwrdd o'r gwaith ac yn mynd i rwyfo ar y llyn. Cadi Ceffylau and Cai Caffi are enjoying a day away from work and go rowing on the lake.

programme.title: Caru Canu
programme.desc: Cân draddodiadol am jac-y-do anarferol iawn a'i ffrindiau. A traditional Welsh nursery song about a very unusual jackdaw and his friends.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Pan mae Eli'n codi moronen, mae hi'n siomedig ei bod yn gam. Ond a yw bod yn gam yn eu hatal rhag bod yn flasus? When Ellie digs up a carrot, she's disappointed to discover it's all wonky.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach...
programme.desc: Byddwn yn teithio i Baris i ddysgu am Pierre Lallement, y dyn wnaeth greu'r beic gyda phedalau nol yn 1863. We learn how bikes work and about the different types, such as motorbikes.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto Gwningen'n denu Mr Cadno gyda'r addewid y bydd yn cael ei goroni'n "Frenin y Coedwigoedd"! Guto lures Mr Cadno with the promise that he will be crowned "King of the Woods'.

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Ifor Hael sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! The challenge is to collect as many clean teeth as possible and win the Dani Dant Trophy.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Newyddion i blant hyd at 6 oed fydd yn diddannu ac yn eu dysgu am y byd o'u cwmpas, yn ei holl amrywiaeth. News for children up to 6 years old, to entertain and educate them about the world.

programme.title: Cymylaubychain
programme.desc: Mae yna gwml rhyfedd iawn wedi cyrraedd y nen sy'n gwneud i bawb disian. Tybed beth yw e? A strange cloud is making everyone sneeze.

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae Harri yn cael galwad i ddweud bod cwch wedi torri yng Nglan Llyn. Yno hefyd mae Tomi wedi cicio pêl i'r llyn! Harri gets a call to say that a boat has broken down in Glan Llyn.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: A fydd defaid Jacson yn difetha gwyl flodau Preston cyn i Mojo a Bo eu corlannu? Jackson's sheep will ruin Preston's flower festival unless Mojo and Bo can round them up.

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Mae Bela wrth ei bodd yn garddio ac yn falch tu hwnt o'i blodau lliwgar. Pan aiff rhai ar goll, mae'n gwybod pwy sydd ar fai - Anni! Bella's colourful flowers go missing - who's to blame.

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae'r Tralalas yn enwi pob anifail sy'n byw yn yr anialwch, ond allwch chi enwi'r planhigyn pigog sy'n tyfu mewn lle poeth a sych fel hyn? The Tralalas explore the hot and dry desert.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd a heddiw mae'n mynd ar ei wyliau. Flying is fun, but the airport is a bit overwhelming. The animals help Pablo work out exactly what he must do.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae 'Rhen Gerwyn yn mwynhau sôn am ei anturiaethau ar y môr ac yn codi ofn ar Twt wrth sôn am fwystfilod môr. Twt doesn't believe in sea monsters but will he change his mind.

programme.title: Blero'n Mynd i Ocido
programme.desc: Mae brêc fflôt carnifal Maer Oci wedi torri.Mae Blero a'i ffrindiau'n trio dal y fflôt. The breaks on Mayor Oci's carnival float have broken.and Blero tries to stop the runaway float.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Mae ein stori ni'n dechrau yn y goedwig. Tra'n mynd am dro, mae Kim a Cêt yn dod o hyd i Twrch. Our story begins in the forest. While going for a walk, Kim and Cêt find Twrch.

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: Mae Mam yn mynd i barti 'baby shower' felly Dad sy'n gyfrifol am y merched heno. When Mum goes out for the evening,Dad takes charge of the girls' evening routine.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Mae Cwstenin Cranc isho dal y sgodyn cnau mwnci fwy na mae o isho cysgu ac ma Joni'n dysgu bod pawb angen seibiant! Cwstenin Cranc wants to catch the peanut fish more than he wants to sleep.

programme.title: A i Y Awyr Iach
programme.desc: 's' am sglefr fyrddio ac 's' am syrffio. Today's letter is S: 's' for 'sglefr fyrddio' (skateboarding) and 'syrffio' (surfing).

programme.title: Ger a Gu
programme.desc: Mae hi'n boeth! Mor boeth fel bod cystadleuaeth cestyll tywod Porthoer wedi'i chanslo! It's hot! So hot that the annual Porthore sandcastle contest is cancelled.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae hi'n amser Eisteddfod Parc Glan Gwil ac mae Sioned Siop am gystadlu. Mae angen dysgu sut i ddawnsio disgo! It's time for the Parc Glan Gwil Eisteddfod & Sioned Siop wants to compete.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C
programme.desc: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd. S4C News & Weather.

programme.title: Y Ci Perffaith
programme.desc: Y tro ma, mae'r teulu Evans yn cael cwmni dau gi - un bach ac un mwy mewn maint. Ond pa un fydd eu Ci Perffaith? Today, the Evans family are joined by two dogs, one small and one larger.

programme.title: Heno

programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No. 7 and his 15-minute orchestral piece Wellington's Victory, Op. 91. The shortest of Beethoven's nine symphonies, Symphony No. 8 lacks a truly slow movement. Instead it has a second movement, Allegretto scherzando, that features a steady ‘ticking' rhythm maintained by the woodwinds throughout the movement. This is thought to be an imitation of the Andante movement of Joseph Haydn's ‘Clock' Symphony. Jordan's performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Martha Argerich
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Teodor Currentzis, Patricia Kopatchinskaja & Ensemble Musica Aeterna
programme.sub-title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia, Konstantin Khvatynets & Boris Berezovsky
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia is joined by acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin. Conductor Konstantin Khvatynets directs this concert, filmed at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow. The programme includes George Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue and Rachmaninov's Rhapsody on a Theme by Paganini and is produced by the Moscow Philharmonic Society, which Saint Petersburg-born composer Dmitri Shostakovich himself once described as playing a significant role "in the development of musical life [in Russia]. It is a kind of university which is attended by millions of music lovers and thousands of musicians.” The Moscow Philharmonic Society was founded in 1922 by then-Commissar for Culture, Anatoly Lunacharsky, and has over the years come to be Russia's leading concert organizing institution.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama. The concert also features the Moka Efti Orchestra, and singers Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, and Nikko Weidemann, as well as dancers of Sweet Burlesque. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2023.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: The LSO performs Dvořák and Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Antonín Dvořák's Scherzo Capriccioso in D-flat major, Op. 66, and selections from Act II of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's famous ballet The Nutcracker (1892). Dvořák's Scherzo Capriccioso (1883) reflects a period of personal crisis for the composer. The work betrays ever-changing moods and a constant sense of inner restlessness. In the music of The Nutcracker, Tchaikovsky combined memorable melodies with colorful orchestration, which has enchanted listeners for decades. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's in London, UK, on March 18, 2021.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer's Piano Concerto No. 3 and his only oratorio, Christ on the Mount of Olives, as well as a reprise performance of his Symphony No. 1. Instead of the traditional minuet, Beethoven wrote a lively scherzo as the third movement of his Symphony No 2. The overall mood of the work is optimistic. Jordan's performance was recorded at Palais Garnier in Paris, France, in 2014.

Souplesse, puissance, rôle des muscles profonds, le corps est étudié sous tous les angles.

programme.title: Non élucidé

programme.title: Non élucidé

Il est retrouvé noyé le 24 décembre. Une information est ouverte pour homicide volontaire, mais le crime n'a jamais été élucidé.

Amir sering mengalami sesak dada dan dia telah membeli insuran nyawa bernilai RM1 juta daripada Fariq sebagai pelindungan kepada isteri dan anaknya. Di hutan tersebut, mereka diganggu oleh penghuni hutan mujur si Papan dapat membantu menenangkan penghuni hutan tersebut dan mereka pun dapat meneruskan perjalanan dengan lancar.

programme.title: Sot
programme.desc: Programi i mëngjesit SOT, është mënyra e duhur për të nisur ditën. Formati më dinamik në ekranet televizive, me shumë informacione për zhvillimet në vend dhe botë. Rubrika të përjavshme dhe ditore. Ekipi i emisionit është i pranishëm çdo ditë në terren. Përmes rubrikës ”Hajt Pak”, programi është shndërruar në zërin e vërtetë të qytetarëve.

programme.title: Te Linda
programme.desc: Kuzhina më e popullarizuar televizive në Kosovë vjen në ekranin e Kohavisionit çdo ditë pune. Receta nga më të ndryshme me plot shije dhe delikatesë e të realizuara me shumë përkushtim edhe për nga ana vizuale, është pa dyshim adresa e duhur për t’u njohur me shijet e reja, por edhe ato tradicionale.

programme.title: Koha e lajmeve
programme.desc: Lajmet e fundit nga vendi dhe bota. Një grup gazetarësh e redaktorësh sjellin të gjitha lajmet në kohë reale nga secili skaj i Kosovës.

programme.title: Jeta
programme.desc: “Jeta”, magazina televizive e cila trajton tema interesante me personazhe të veçantë dhe sjell rubrika atraktive vjen në transmetim të dielave mbrëma në Kohavision. Histori suksesi, personazhe interesante dhe rrëfime në studio janë pjesë e emisionit, i cili sjell çdo javë rubrikën e popullarizuar ”Shqiptarët nëpër botë”.

programme.title: Rreth botes
programme.desc: ”Rreth botes” ju shpie rrotull globit me permbajtje informative, duke risjelle momentet te cilat shenojne javen. Analiza me njohes te zhvillimeve nderkombetare sjellin permbledhjen e ngjarjeve kryes.

programme.title: N’mes t’ditës
programme.desc: Për t’i shtuar shije paraditës pas informatave të hershme të mëngjesit, në një format të kombinuar mes kulturës dhe showbizzit, Erëza sjellë pranë jush çdo gjë që ndodh rreth e qark nesh, drejtëpërdrejtë nga kryeqytetet Prishtinë – Tiranë, brenda dhe jashtë vendit e trajtuar me informatat pikante.

programme.title: Express
programme.desc: ”Express” është emisioni televiziv me historinë më të gjatë në transmetim ndër televizionet kosovare. Në sezonin e shtatëmbëdhjetë vazhdon të jetë emisioni i pasdites për kosovarët. Magazina e pasdites në KTV është adresë për tema nga fusha të ndryshme, që nga zhvillimet politike e sociale, e deri te lajmet nga kultura, showbizi dhe sporti.

programme.title: Lajmet e mbrëmjes

programme.desc: Snajper strzela do ludzi na bazarze. Ginie mężczyzna badający aferę finansową. Odsunięta od śledztwa Monika prowadzi własne dochodzenie, które łączy się z jej przeszłością.

programme.title: Nic śmiesznego
programme.desc: Adam Miauczyński to reżyser filmów porno. Został nim w nadziei zdobycia sławy i bogactwa. Ale mija już czterdziestka, a jego marzeniom wciąż daleko do realizacji. Długi czas był tylko drugim reżyserem, na dodatek stale wyrzucanym z pracy.

programme.title: Archiwista
programme.desc: Henrykowi nie daje spokoju sprawa śmierci Bożyńskiego. Jego podejrzenia wzbudza lekarz, który wystawił akt zgonu. Kilka lat wcześniej był oskarżany o spowodowanie śmierci pacjenta, ale ostatecznie syn ofiary wycofał zarzuty.

programme.title: Archiwista
programme.desc: Późnym wieczorem mężczyzna przychodzi do znajomego, do domku letniskowego na wódkę. Zostaje ogłuszony przez gospodarza i utopiony w misce z wodą. Nazajutrz na komendzie zjawia Zenon Kurtyba, który twierdzi, że był świadkiem zbrodni.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: W okolicach kościoła Natalia znajduje martwego mężczyznę. Okazuje się, że zmarł z wycieńczenia. W mieście niedawno została zamknięta noclegownia. W parku znaleziono kolejnego martwego mężczyznę. Sekcja wskazuje na zatrucie alkaloidem. Trop prowadzi do kościoła. Okazuje się, że ktoś chciał otruć księdza Mateusza.

programme.title: My, ewangelicy warszawscy
programme.desc: Ich początki w stolicy sięgają czasów, gdy ewangelicy reformowani nie mogli swobodnie spotykać się. Dzisiaj ta warszawska wspólnota ma już dwieście pięćdziesiąt lat. Jej historia jest również historią troski o drugiego człowieka...

programme.title: Gwiazdorska kuchnia Ani
programme.desc: W tym odcinku gościem Anny Strażyńskiej jest Alessandro Parrello.

programme.title: Zaginione? Ocalone? Historie zawodów różnych
programme.desc: W tym odcinku cyklu Zaginione? Ocalone? Historie zawodów różnych - wizyta w warsztacie zecera.

programme.title: Blondynka
programme.desc: Na przystani w Majakach na kapitana czeka Jagna z rodziną. Kapitan ma przypłynąć stateczkiem, który będzie ich nowym domem. Sylwia towarzyszy przyjaciołom. Kapitan istotnie przypływa lecz nie statkiem turystycznym, ale łódeczką.

programme.title: Blondynka
programme.desc: Przez prześwietlone słońcem majakowe łąki idzie Auguścik, zbiera kwiaty. Bukiet przeznaczony jest dla Sylwii, która jeszcze tego samego dnia zostanie Kobietą Roku Podlasia.

programme.title: Zmiennicy
programme.desc: Znany reżyser Barewicz otrzymuje wiadomość, że na festiwalu filmowym w Berlinie Zachodnim przyznano mu Grand Prix i nagrodę rzeczową w postaci mercedesa. Natychmiast wyrusza na przejście graniczne po odbiór samochodu.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Bruno udaje przed dziewczyną, że jest piłkarzem, chociaż nie potrafi grać. Za to Zuza staje się cleanfluencerką, która nie potrafi sprzątać, a Maja wspomina przygody z mamą, w które nikt nie chce jej uwierzyć.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: W następstwie publikacji artykułu Weroniki, Borys występuje do pana Bogumiła z nową propozycją ugody, na którą mężczyzna przystaje. Rozmowa Huberta z Adamem przeradza się w otwarty konflikt, co budzi nieskrywaną satysfakcję Wilka i Lucyny.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Reportaże o niezwykłych miejscach w Polsce. W tym odcinku: dziennikarski Żoliborz.

programme.title: Wojenne dziewczyny
programme.desc: Major Powała przesłuchuje Kamila Brodzkiego. Nie wierzy, że porucznik cierpi na całkowitą amnezję. Do pokoju wchodzi niespodziewanie Irka, podbiega do Kamila, lecz on jej nie poznaje. Irka ma żal do brata, że ukrywał przed nią prawdę.

programme.title: Dom
programme.desc: W kamienicy na Złotej pojawia się pierwszy telewizor. Szczęśliwymi posiadaczami są Wrotkowie. Andrzej i Wiktor chcą postawić na cmentarzu w Sierpuchowie pomnik upamiętniający walkę i śmierć ich przyjaciół z AK.

programme.title: Muzyczne naj
programme.desc: W tym odcinku pojawiają się utwory, muzyka i historia dokonań scenicznych Edyty Geppert.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Snajper strzela do ludzi na bazarze. Ginie mężczyzna badający aferę finansową. Odsunięta od śledztwa Monika prowadzi własne dochodzenie, które łączy się z jej przeszłością.

programme.title: Nic śmiesznego
programme.desc: Adam Miauczyński to reżyser filmów porno. Został nim w nadziei zdobycia sławy i bogactwa. Ale mija już czterdziestka, a jego marzeniom wciąż daleko do realizacji. Długi czas był tylko drugim reżyserem, na dodatek stale wyrzucanym z pracy.

programme.title: W światłach zorzy
programme.desc: Na dalekiej północy, w Laponii, czas płynie inaczej. Surowe warunki, które zmuszają mieszkańców do korzystania z psich zaprzęgów, wydają się Monice i Maćkowi spełnieniem ich marzeń. Film przedstawia kilka dni z życia polskiej rodziny, która w 2017 roku zdecydowała się zamieszkać w jednym z najzimniejszych miejsc na Ziemi.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: W następstwie publikacji artykułu Weroniki, Borys występuje do pana Bogumiła z nową propozycją ugody, na którą mężczyzna przystaje. Rozmowa Huberta z Adamem przeradza się w otwarty konflikt, co budzi nieskrywaną satysfakcję Wilka i Lucyny.

programme.title: Rączka gotuje
programme.desc: Remigiusz Rączka kontynuuje jesienną rajzę po Śląsku, żeby sprawdzić, jak zmienia się nasz region. Tym razem odwiedza teren po byłej kopalni Rozbark w Bytomiu. W Izbie Tradycji gotuje wspólnie z młodzieżą - uczestnikami konkursu "TransformujeMY Śląskie. Młodzi dla młodych", a w menu kapuśniak na gęsinie i torcik cwibakowy.

programme.title: Na tropach historii
programme.desc: Cykl przybliżający historię województwa świętokrzyskiego. Opisując zrywy narodowe, klęski, wielkie i małe zwycięstwa, najnowsze odkrycia archeologiczne i geologiczne. Podążamy śladami, które pozostawiła historia.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Snajper strzela do ludzi na bazarze. Ginie mężczyzna badający aferę finansową. Odsunięta od śledztwa Monika prowadzi własne dochodzenie, które łączy się z jej przeszłością.

programme.title: Ranczo
programme.desc: Kontynuacja popularnego serialu komediowego o tematyce obyczajowej. Serial opowiada o perypetiach młodej Amerykanki, która na skutek splotu różnych okoliczności życiowych osiedla się w małej, podlaskiej wsi Wilkowyje.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Aleksander Brückner wybitny slawista, badacz języka i kultury polskiej urodził się 29 stycznia 1856 roku w Tarnopolu. Kształcił się w Lipsku, Berlinie i Wiedniu. W wieku 25 lat rozpoczął współpracę z katedrą języków i literatur słowiańskich.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Patrycja odkrywa, że jej postać w serialu zostanie uśmiercona, a Zuza organizuje internetową kampanię ratunkową. Sylwester unika rozmowy z Mają o stracie mamy, ale w końcu musi się z tym zmierzyć. Patrycja dostaje rolę życia. Czy wyprowadzi się i zniknie z rodziny Dzików?

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Kiedy Adam ponownie powraca do domu Pyrków pod wpływem środków odurzających i pozbawia domowników zapasów na śniadanie, Joanna z trudem panuje nad wzburzeniem. Lokator nie traci jednak rezonu i wkrótce prosi Huberta o kolejną pożyczkę.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Jasiek jest przetrzymywany w areszcie. Władek i Kazia są bezsilni. Wiedzą, że Łucja widziała całe zdarzenie, ale milczy. Proszą o pomoc Bronię. Babka Winna żąda, by dziewczyna powiedziała policji prawdę. Posuwa się do groźby.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: W klasie Zosi Nocul jest nowa uczennica Julka, dziewczynki zaprzyjaźniają się. Rodzina Julki przeprowadziła się do Sandomierza, chroni ich policja. Ojciec jest świadkiem koronnym w procesie mafii. W szkole trwają poszukiwania Zosi i Julki.

programme.title: Profesor Michałowski. Droga do Faras
programme.desc: Historia najwybitniejszego polskiego archeologa, prof. Kazimierza Michałowskiego i jego największego odkrycia w Faras. Bez jego determinacji i pasji nie byłoby polskiej archeologii z jej międzynarodowymi sukcesami i pozycją, jaką ma dziś.

programme.title: Top of the Wave:2
programme.desc: 紀實節目《Top of the Wave》，正是從這片浪潮中誕生。節目以台灣為起點，跟隨一群台灣衝浪選手，從國內的訓練日常出發，踏上與世界較量的旅程。陳懷本來自不靠海的南投，卻把大海當成生命的方向，在一次次的浪頭與落敗之間，重新定義自己；詹博宇成長於美國聖地牙哥，在太平洋兩岸的文化夾縫中長大，衝浪對他而言從不只是熟悉的運動，更是一條通往身分認同的路。

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

Tenant Helen Brent (Claire Trevor) discovers the bodies, but instead of reporting the crime, she leaves for San Francisco as planned to return to her wealthy fiancé. On the same train, Sam flirts with Helen, then tracks her to her half-sister's house, where he continues to pursue her. Although Helen suspects Sam is a murderer, she inexplicably protects him from an investigator.

As he frantically tries to unravel the mystery behind his own impending demise, his sleuthing leads him to a group of crooked businessmen and another murder.

Bill promises her that they will be together after he becomes a success. However, he and Selina both skyrocket to fame and lose contact. Fortunately, Bill just might get one more chance to woo Selina at a huge musical stage show. Popular entertainers of the 1940s, including Fats Waller and Cab Calloway, perform as themselves in the film.

programme.title: A Song Is Born
programme.desc: A group of music professors, including Frisbee (Danny Kaye) and Magenbruch (Benny Goodman), are writing an encyclopedia of music. A pair of window washers introduces the duo to a pioneering musical form called jazz. Frisbee and Magenbruch start going to nightclubs to hear the new sound and become involved with club singer Honey Swanson (Virginia Mayo), who is running from police because they want her to inform on her gangster boyfriend, Tony Crow (Steve Cochran).

programme.title: Reveille With Beverly
programme.desc: As the substitute host on a morning radio program, former switchboard operator Beverly Ross (Ann Miller) becomes a local sensation when she changes the format to hot boogie-woogie. Wanting to meet the mysterious disc jockey, millionaire Barry Lang (William Wright) switches identities with his chauffeur, Andy Adams (Dick Purcell), so Barry can woo her without revealing his wealth. When Beverly's new job is jeopardized, they team up with soldiers at a nearby military base to save her show.

programme.title: Hollywood Hotel
programme.desc: After losing a coveted role in an upcoming film to another actress, screen queen Mona Marshall (Lola Lane) protests by refusing to appear at her current movie's premiere. Her agent discovers struggling actress Virginia Stanton (Rosemary Lane) -- an exact match for Mona -- and sends her to the premiere instead, with young musician Ronnie Bowers (Dick Powell). After various mishaps, including a case of mistaken identity, Ronnie and Virginia struggle to find success in Hollywood.

programme.title: Ship Ahoy
programme.desc: Tallulah Winters (Eleanor Powell), a Broadway dancer, is inadvertently involved in a spy plot when she agrees to carry a vital piece of equipment on a cruise to Rio. The spy ringleader got the idea of using an entertainer from a story by eccentric dime magazine writer Merton K. Kibble (Red Skelton) -- whose friend Skip Owens (Bert Lahr) has convinced him to take the cruise as well. Tallulah and Merton hit it off, until Tallulah overhears him discussing a plot for a story and thinks he is a spy.

programme.title: Du Barry Was a Lady
programme.desc: In this adaptation of a Cole Porter Broadway musical, star singer May wants to marry a rich man, but her heart belongs to a penniless dancer named Alec. Louis Blore, who has just won a fortune through the sweepstakes, promptly marries May. However, after Louis accidentally has a laced drink, he has a fantastic dream in which he, May and Alec are members of the royal French court. Once Louis awakens, he begins to reconsider his relationship with May.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Sea
programme.desc: An old Cuban fisherman (Spencer Tracy) has not caught anything in 84 days. Despite the devotion of the young boy (Felipe Pazos) who brings him coffee and food, the fisherman fears he has become perpetually unlucky. On his 85th day of fishing, the old man catches a small fish and decides to keep fishing. When one of his multiple fishing lines hooks a large marlin, he decides to not return to shore until he reels in the fish. For two days and nights, the man sits alone, waiting to redeem himself.

programme.title: Malaya
programme.desc: Soon after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, cynical former newspaper correspondent John Royer (James Stewart) devises a scheme with his old editor and government agents to return to the Far East and smuggle out a vast amount of rubber for the war effort. Demanding the freedom and company of his ex-friend, Carnahan (Spencer Tracy), whom he betrayed in an exposé years earlier, Royer sails off into the hands of the Japanese with a motley crew, gold and the promise of covert government aid.

programme.title: Northwest Passage

Langdon Towne and Hunk Marriner joined the Rangers at the Indian village, but when they head on to Fort Wentworth, they find the place deserted.

programme.title: Plymouth Adventure
programme.desc: Stubborn Capt. Christopher Jones (Spencer Tracy) pilots the historically famous Mayflower on its maiden voyage across the storm-swept Atlantic. Thankfully, a resourceful carpenter (Van Johnson) keeps the weather damage in check. Also among the passengers is Dorothy (Gene Tierney), the wife of the religiously zealous leader of the pilgrims. Jones finds himself drawn to Dorothy, despite her unattainable status. Soon a rivalry between his unsavory crew and the prim and proper pilgrims emerges.

programme.title: Executive Action
programme.desc: In 1963, with President John F. The swaggering Foster (Robert Ryan) wants JFK dead, but the mysterious and powerful Ferguson (Will Geer) rebuffs the idea. Still, Farrington (Burt Lancaster) carries out a military training operation in preparation for an assassination while he waits for a decision.

programme.title: The Cassandra Crossing
programme.desc: Terrorists have planted a deadly virus on a transcontinental train. They can't get off, and one solution proposed is to quarantine them by rerouting the train over the Cassandra Crossing -- an unstable bridge. Dr. Chamberlain wants to save them, but has to battle the terrorists first.

programme.title: Field of Dreams

programme.title: Ulzana's Raid

programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoune (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Canton (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. Quick doesn't exactly help the situation when he falls for Calhoun's gun moll, Miss Dominique La Rue (Jasmine Guy).

programme.title: The Honeymooners
programme.desc: Ralph Kramden (Cedric the Entertainer) drives a bus in New York City but dreams of something more. Unfortunately, none of Ralph's business ideas -- which often incorporate his best friend, Ed (Mike Epps) -- have panned out. Knowing their husbands will never get them out of the city, Ralph's wife, Alice (Gabrielle Union), and Ed's wife, Trixie (Regina Hall), pool their savings to purchase a house in the suburbs. But once the men find out about the secret stash, they might just blow it all.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: In the wake of her mother's death in a mental institution, detective Rita Veder (Angela Bassett) is assigned to a baffling serial murder case. After examining the crime scene -- a corpse-filled ship found adrift at sea -- Rita meets Maximilian (Eddie Murphy), a smooth-talking Caribbean playboy determined to romance her. When Rita begins suffering from crippling hallucinations, she calls upon Dr. Zeko (Zakes Mokae), an occultist who suspects a vampire is on the loose.

Bei der Suche nach dem Traumkleid helfen die routinierten Brautmodenexperten der Doku-Soap.

programme.title: First Dates – Ein Tisch für zwei
programme.desc: Starkoch Trettl („The Taste“-Juror von 2016 bis 2018) begrüßt die einsamen Herzen, die vorab anhand von Vorlieben und Abneigungen ausgewählt wurden, dann zieht er sich zurück und beobachtet, ob sich die Paare zwischen Salat und Dessert näherkommen. Nach dem Menü stellt sich die Frage: Gibt es ein weiteres Date?

programme.title: Hot oder Schrott – Die Allestester
programme.desc: Erfindungen, die die Welt nicht braucht, werden bei "Hot oder Schrott" auf den Prüfstand gestellt. Die Allestester unterziehen nützliche und skurrile Artikel dem Praxistest. Кораловият град S1 E4 С настъпването на зимата животът на оживения риф се забавя. Рифови акули и октоподи бродят наоколо, а е показан и коралов оазис върху стар потънал кораб.

programme.desc: 都柏林50公里外，一座有300年歷史嘅監獄。監獄人滿為患，糧食不足，枉死嘅囚犯不計其數，仲發生過多宗靈異事件。193同米露迪闖入監獄地牢以及囚室，同死囚嘅靈體緊密接觸！佢哋仲會嘗試用食物，吸引因為大飢荒而餓死嘅囚犯亡魂，靈探儀器嘅反應係...？

programme.title: 偶然遇見的你 第16集
programme.desc: 隨著海俊和允英進行的每一次調查，案件變得更加撲朔迷離。在姐姐去世後的負面情緒中，順愛更擔心的是她母親。在一個風平浪靜的夜晚，當一切都顯得平靜時，海俊接到一個緊急電話…

programme.title: 我的明星製作人 第7集
programme.desc: 秀賢與Chris見面，警告他不要打擾振宇。一間小報威脅秀賢，說他們會公佈她濫用權力對抗 RAID 的影片。秀賢拿到了原始檔案，當她發現是誰拍攝時，她大吃一驚…尹熙慘死的原因被揭曉。在聽說振宇通過試鏡後，賢哲更加決心要打倒秀賢，於是他與節目製作人見面並迫使他淘汰振宇。

programme.title: 晚吹
programme.desc: 男人該如何面對覺醒（WOKE）的美好新世界？ 為紓緩廣大男士焦慮和不安，193、阿Thor、灘叔，每星期都會同你圍爐亂講一通，一齊笑著尋找當下世界觀、刷新固有價值觀、重塑男人三十、四十、五十路人生觀！唔係要話人知男人曾經有幾威，而係要居安思危、探討家下男人有幾閉翳！

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度 第1501集
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息。

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.desc: 菲比（莉莎·庫卓 Lisa Kudrow 飾）和瑞秋（詹妮弗·安妮斯頓 Jennifer Aniston 飾）的公寓已經修復完畢，菲比搬回了公寓，瑞秋繼續和喬伊（馬特·理勃蘭 Matt LeBlanc 飾）住在一起。喬伊在《Days of Our Lives》劇組裡得到了一個角色。就在錢德勒（馬修·派瑞 Matthew Perry 飾）和摩妮卡（柯特妮·考克斯 Courteney Cox 飾）的婚禮前一夜，錢德勒突然臨陣畏縮，逃走躲了起來。他走了之後，菲比在衛生間找了一支顯示有孕的驗孕棒，從而斷定摩妮卡有了身孕。菲比和羅斯（大衛·史威默 David Schwimmer 飾）在辦公室找到了躲藏錢德勒並說服他回來，回來後他聽到了菲比與瑞秋的竊竊私語——摩妮卡懷孕了！最後錢德勒和摩妮卡順利完婚，但摩妮卡卻說自己並沒有懷孕時。那麼，懷孕的人難道是瑞秋嗎？

programme.desc: 西蒙·貝克（Simon Baker）飾演派屈克·簡（Patrick Jane），一名受僱於加州調查局（California Bureau of Investigation，CBI）之獨立顧問。他利用出色的觀察技巧（如讀心術），成功偵破多宗大案。他過去經常使用所謂的心靈感應，曾假裝擁有通靈能力的靈媒而成名。派屈克·簡在一電視節目透露使用心靈感應協助警方調查連環殺手「紅約翰」（Red John），他的妻女因而被其殺害。在自責之下，他放棄作為騙人的靈媒，成為警方顧問。

programme.title: 卡那洛效應第3季:13
programme.desc: 麥可卡那洛是一個職業魔術師，卻是個愛開玩笑的人，他在一些很平常的場合裡，對一些猜想不到的人表演難解的魔術，全都被隱藏式攝影機拍下。

programme.title: 生活冷知識第2季:20
programme.desc: 歡迎來到由 Kevin Pereira 和 Brooke Van Poppelen 主持的每週節目，該節目以喜劇形式講述了永無止境的日常生活小貼士。 從學習如何用鞋子打開一瓶酒，到找出衛生紙捲的多種用途，永遠不乏有待發現的訣竅。 觀眾請注意：你們的生活將永遠不一樣。

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.sub-title: Winchester Life - "The Best of Winchester Life
programme.desc: A "Best of..." episode spanning the past 4 seasons of Winchester Life.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester's new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado's rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West's toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi day deer camp. Along for the ride are outdoor editors Scott Ergas and Dave Hurteau. Chris and Casey are on the search for some large bucks, as well as showing the people at the camp a great time and what deer season is all about.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: Neville sitzt in einer Bar und versucht, gedanklich sein Leben wieder in Ordnung zu bringen. Plötzlich kommt am Nachbartisch ein Mann ums Leben. Es gibt mehrere Verdächtige, Neville findet jedoch heraus, dass der Mord etwas mit alten Musikproduzenten, Schallplatten und Calypso-Musik zu tun hat. Doch wo genau ist der Zusammenhang? programme.title: The Rookie
programme.desc: Celina erlebt ihren ersten Tag in Zivil – Nolan darf nur beobachten. Während das Vertrauen in die Polizei schwindet, sorgt der selbst ernannte "Watcher" für Unruhe in der Stadt. programme.title: Bares für Rares

programme.title: Immer Ärger mit Grandpa

Sohnemann Peter muss dafür sein Zimmer räumen und auf den staubigen Dachboden ziehen. Keine gute Idee! Peter stellt seinem Opa ein Ultimatum. Er hat 24 Stunden Zeit, das Zimmer wieder zu verlasse

programme.title: Madame Annie und ihre Familie
programme.desc: Als Annie (Alexandra Lamy) im Mülleimer einen positiven Schwangerschaftstest findet, will sie wissen: Wem aus ihrer sechsköpfigen Familie gehört der? Natürlich will keiner darauf antworten… \n\nHumorvolles, turbulentes Familienchaos, das eher auf leise Situationskomik als brachial-quatschigen Klamauk setzt.

programme.title: Das Mädchen deiner Träume
programme.desc: Lucy (Lily Sullivan) stellt das Leben des schizophrenen Devon (Brenton Thwaites) auf den Kopf, bevor sie spurlos verschwindet. Existiert sie nur in seiner Vorstellung? Der Musiker reist auf der Suche quer durch Australien, den besorgten Bruder im Schlepptau. \n\nBittersüßer Mix aus Lovestory und Roadmovie.

Sa cuisson demande une grande précision, comme l'explique un spécialiste local. L'émission nous emmène ensuite au Brésil à la rencontre de Yann, un chef nordiste expatrié. Il enseigne les techniques françaises à ses élèves et adapte le waterzoï aux produits locaux.

programme.title: Invitation au voyage
programme.desc: En Suède, la grande saga des émigrants - A Naples, un Dieu nommé Maradona - En France, le colombo d'agneau de Nicole et Raymonde - Au Royaume-Uni, à la force des poings.

programme.title: Invitation au voyage
programme.desc: La Thaïlande venimeuse de "The White Lotus" - Les Parsis, bâtisseurs de l'Inde - Porto Rico, le ragoût de lapin d'Andrea et Annie - Amazonie, prenez garde aux piranhas, ou pas.

programme.title: Vatican : La cité qui voulait devenir éternelle
programme.desc: Comment la tombe de l'apôtre Pierre, sur l'une des collines de Rome, est-elle devenue le siège universel de la chrétienté, en même temps qu'un centre politique et artistique majeur ? programme.title: Lucrèce Borgia : Intrigues, crimes et politique à la cour du pape
programme.desc: Fille naturelle du cardinal Rodrigo Borgia, futur pape sous le nom d'Alexandre VI et devenu célèbre pour ses mœurs dissolues, Lucrèce Borgia (1480-1519) a bénéficié, comme ses trois frères, notamment l'ambitieux César Borgia, d'une éducation privilégiée. programme.title: Histoires d'eaux
programme.desc: Inédit. Du Danube à la Dordogne en passant par la Tara, plongée dans les plus beaux lacs, rivières et cours d'eau d'Europe.

programme.title: Slovaquie : surtourisme dans un village classé
programme.desc: Inédit. "Accès et photos interdits", lit-on sur les panneaux qu'Anton Sabucha a fixés devant sa propriété à Vlkolínec. Inscrit sur la liste du patrimoine mondial de l'Unesco, ce village slovaque ploie sous les 100 000 touristes qui s'y pressent chaque année pour voir ses maisons traditionnelles en bois. Or, Anton exige que le village soit rayé de la liste pour échapper au surtourisme.

programme.title: Les pleins pouvoirs
programme.desc: Luther Whitney, cambrioleur et artiste-peintre à ses heures perdues, est occupé à dévaliser une chambre forte dans la demeure d'un milliardaire en vacances. Il rêve au vin de Bordeaux qu'il boira à l'issue de l'entreprise. programme.title: Histoires d'eaux
programme.desc: Focus sur la Saale, une rivière aux multiples facettes qui serpente sur plus de 413 kilomètres à travers des formations géologiques variées.

programme.title: Invitation au voyage

programme.title: Voyage en cuisine
programme.desc: Une plongée au coeur des traditions culinaires d'Izmir avec une présentation de l'artichaut Sakiz, un ingrédient phare de la gastronomie turque. De sa récolte locale à son histoire dans les assiettes ottomanes racontée par un géographe, ce légume voyage jusqu'à Cannes où un expatrié retrouve les saveurs de son pays. Enfin, focus sur la préparation de délicieux artichauts farcis grâce à une recette

programme.title: Le dessous des images
programme.desc: Inédit. La carlingue d'un avion américain révèle l'ampleur des dégâts infligés à l'armée états-unienne par l'Iran. Cette photographie, publiée le 15 septembre 2026 par CBS, ouvre une brèche dans le narratif officiel de l'administration Trump, qui cherche à contrôler la couverture médiatique de cette guerre.

programme.title: Arte journal
programme.desc: Chaque jour à 19h45, la rédaction franco-allemande d'ARTE Journal propose une approche européenne et culturelle de l'actualité. Un regard original sur le monde.

programme.title: 28 minutes
programme.desc: Inédit. 28 minutes samedi apporte un éclairage tout particulier à l'actualité sociétale et internationale de la semaine écoulée. Renaud Dély invite chaque semaine une personnalité connue et reconnue dans son domaine. À ses côtés tout au long de l'émission, elle réagira aux débats et autres séquences de ce rendez-vous hebdomadaire.

programme.title: Le dessous des cartes : l'essentiel
programme.desc: Inédit. "Le dessous des cartes" met son expertise géopolitique au service d'un décryptage en quatre minutes des grands événements qui secouent le monde contemporain.

programme.title: Il était une fois Gaza
programme.desc: Inédit. Autrefois carrefour stratégique majeur, Gaza a vu son destin basculer avec la création de l'Etat d'Israël en 1948 et la Nakba, l'exode forcé de centaines de milliers de Palestiniens. Devenue une enclave surpeuplée, elle est militairement occupée par Israël dès 1967. Malgré les espoirs des accords d'Oslo, ce territoire est aujourd'hui tragiquement sacrifié.

programme.title: Il était une fois Gaza
programme.desc: Inédit. Au travers d'archives rares, d'éclairages et de poignants témoignages, ce documentaire retrace un siècle de l'histoire de Gaza, et montre comment, sous la pression d'Israël, cette ancienne oasis a été ravagée par une spirale de violences sans fin. Jusqu'à la guerre d'anéantissement en cours.

programme.title: No Other Land
programme.desc: Inédit. Depuis plus de cinq ans, Basel Adra, un activiste palestinien originaire de Masafer Yatta, une région montagneuse de Cisjordanie, filme l'expulsion des membres de sa communauté par l'occupant israélien, qui détruit méthodiquement les villages et en chasse ses habitants. programme.title: Palestine, le pouvoir en ruines
programme.desc: Inédit. À Gaza et en Cisjordanie, les responsables politiques gouvernent sous les bombes. Comment, en pleine guerre d'anéantissement, garantir l'accès à l'eau, déblayer les ruines ou repousser les attaques des colons ? Nourri d'images rares et de témoignages, ce documentaire interroge la possibilité d'un avenir politique en Palestine.

programme.title: Syrie, Assad et après
programme.desc: Syrie, année zéro : le pays traverse une phase de transition difficile depuis la chute de Bachar al-Assad et l'arrivée au pouvoir d'Ahmed al-Chaara, chef du groupe rebelle islamiste Hayat Tahrir al-Cham, en décembre 2024. La dictature est certes terminée, mais les bouleversements politiques ont mis en évidence des tensions sociales profondément enracinées. Les minorités craignent pour leurs droits

programme.title: STOP
programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. Akte humanizmi për më të pamundurit e fatkeqët, të cilëve u ndryshon jeta. Nje emision i gjithi vetëm për njerëzit e zakonshëm dhe me njerëzit në qendër.

programme.title: Aldo Morning Show
programme.desc: Dielli lind ndryshe në TVKLAN, në 7 pa 1 minutë! Të lodhur apo të palodhur nga gjumi i natës, nga e djeshmja me halle e strese, Aldo ju fton të zgjohemi me buzeqeshje, me qeshje, me nënqeshje, dhe më kryesorja. me një adrenaline të paparë për ta nisu.

programme.title: Shije Shtepie
programme.desc: Emision edukues - informues - argëtues me zn.Tefta e Katerina Trungu. Çdo ditë me recetat e thjeshta dhe mbi të gjitha ekonomike të Zj.Vjollca duke edukuar amvisat si të ushqehemi shëndetshëm. Rubrika te ndryshme me te ftuar speciale me këshilla te thjeshta praktike, të kuptueshme nga te gjithë, për cdo aspekt të të përditshmes.

programme.title: Shtëpiake të dëshpëruara
programme.desc: Komedia me skenarin me te mire te pershtatur nga versioni amerikan. Jeta dhe dashurite e pese heroinave te serialit qe jetojne ne rrugicen ”Trendafil”: Jasemin, Nermin, Zelish, Elif dhe Emel.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: NEHIR
programme.desc: Ndertimi i nje dige do te shnderrohet ne nje vend ku dashuria ”permbyt” gjithçka. E gjitha filloi kur inxhinieri Nazim, nje ish i dashuruar i lenduar, me nje zemer te arte, njihet ”online” me gruan e endrrave te tij, Nehir. Ata shkruheshin per muaj te tere duke u lidhur shume me njeri-tjetrin. Ne panik nje dite ai zgjedh nje portret simpatik duke e genjyer ate dhe ajo u dashurua me ate genjeshter...

programme.title: Të braktisurit
programme.desc: Kur jeta të merr gjithçka, mbetet vetëm forca për të luftuar. Një histori e jashtezakonshme për familjen, sakrificën dhe shpresën. Mes vështirësive dhe padrejtësive, ata kanë vetëm njëri-tjetrin. Një serial i mbushur me emocione të forta dhe momente të paharrueshme. Rrugëtimi emocionues i gjashtë fëmijëve jetimë që luftojnë për të mbetur bashkë në një botë që përpiqet t’i ndajë. Seriali qe ka prekur zemrat e miliona shikuesve dhe me i klikuari ne mediat sociale me disa aktore yje.

programme.title: Tradhtia
programme.desc: Ajo besoi tek dashuria dhe tek familja. Besoi se pas 30 vitesh martesë, e njihte njeriun që kishte në krah. Gyzide ka ndërtuar jetën e saj mbi drejtësinë. Por tani, drejtësinë do ta kërkojë brenda familjes së saj. Kur e vërteta del në dritë, asgjë nuk do të jetë më si më parë. A mund ta rindërtosh jetën pasi zbulon se gjithçka që besoje ishte një gënjeshtër? Vahide Perçin në një nga rolet më të fuqishme të karrierës së saj.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Mëkate dhe trëndafila
programme.desc: Një sekret i fshehur për vite me radhë. Një familje në prag të shkatërrimit. Dhe një dashuri që lind mes dhimbjes dhe së vërtetës. Çdo trëndafil fsheh një sekret dhe çdo mëkat ka një çmim. Ai besonte te familja. Ajo besonte te e vërteta. Por kur sekretet dalin në dritë, asgjë nuk mbetet si më parë. Dashuri, tradhti dhe emocione që sfidojnë fatin. Me aktoret e famshem: Cemre Baysel dhe Murat Yildirim.

programme.title: Rudina
programme.desc: Një show argëtues dhe informativ nga Rudina Magjistari, që e shoqeron çdo pasdite familjet shqiptare me të ftuar të shumtë e VIP, por dhe njerez të e thjeshte me historitë e tyre personale.

programme.title: Mashtruesit
programme.desc: Një dramë e mbushur me intriga, sekrete, dhe lojëra të rrezikshme, ku e vërteta dhe gënjeshtra ndërthuren në çdo hap. Ertan, një avokat i talentuar i cili së bashku me të atin, nuk heziton të përdorë metoda të pazakonta për të fituar çështjet e tyre dhe Asja, një grua që përballet me vështirësi të mëdha dhe detyrohet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe mashtrimin për të mbajtur familjen e saj. Sa më shumë zbulohen sekretet, aq më shumë bëhet e vështirë të dallosh se kush është viktimë, kush është mashtrue.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: STOP
programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. Akte humanizmi për më të pamundurit e fatkeqët, të cilëve u ndryshon jeta. Nje emision i gjithi vetëm për njerëzit e zakonshëm dhe me njerëzit në qendër.

programme.title: Gjeniu
programme.desc: Një gjeni i tradhëtuar nga njeriu që duhej ta mbronte. Mes sekreteve, pushtetit dhe lojërave të mendjes, fillon një betejë ku fiton vetëm më i zgjuari. Devran është një djalë me inteligjencë të jashtëzakonshme, jeta e të cilit ndryshon për shkak të tradhtisë së babait të tij. Një lojë të rrezikshme mendjesh, ku çdo lëvizje është e llogaritur dhe çdo aleancë mund të fshehë një tradhti. Ndërsa sekretet e së kaluarës dalin në dritë, Devrani duhet të zgjedhë mes hakmarrjes dhe njerëzve që do. Fitues.

programme.title: Opinion
programme.desc: Emisioni politik më i ndjekur dhe më i preferuar në ekranet shqiptare nga Blendi Fevziu. Arena e politikës shqiptare që prej 31 gushtit 1997. Komente, analiza, debate, personazhe, dëshmi dhe fakte konkrete. Ngjarjet më të fundit dhe më të rëndësishme.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Karteli
programme.desc: Vellezerit qe krijuan perandorine me te madhe te krimit te organizuar ne Cali gjate viteve ’60 - ’70. Familja, romancat dhe ambicja e dy vellezerve per te mbreteruar industrine e droges ne Kolumbi. Vellezerit Villegas, te njohur ndryshe si ”Los Caballeros de Cali”, kriminelet me te kerkuar ne te gjithe boten... Historia e vertete se si ata u bene nga femije te varfer, ne boset e droges. Bazuar ne librin ”El cartel de los sapos” te Andres Lopez.

programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. Akte humanizmi për më të pamundurit e fatkeqët, të cilëve u ndryshon jeta. Nje emision i gjithi vetëm për njerëzit e zakonshëm dhe me njerëzit në qendër.

programme.title: Gjeniu
programme.desc: Një gjeni i tradhëtuar nga njeriu që duhej ta mbronte. Mes sekreteve, pushtetit dhe lojërave të mendjes, fillon një betejë ku fiton vetëm më i zgjuari. Devran është një djalë me inteligjencë të jashtëzakonshme, jeta e të cilit ndryshon për shkak të tradhtisë së babait të tij. Një lojë të rrezikshme mendjesh, ku çdo lëvizje është e llogaritur dhe çdo aleancë mund të fshehë një tradhti. Ndërsa sekretet e së kaluarës dalin në dritë, Devrani duhet të zgjedhë mes hakmarrjes dhe njerëzve që do. Fitues.

programme.title: Opinion
programme.desc: Emisioni politik më i ndjekur dhe më i preferuar në ekranet shqiptare nga Blendi Fevziu. Arena e politikës shqiptare që prej 31 gushtit 1997. Komente, analiza, debate, personazhe, dëshmi dhe fakte konkrete. Ngjarjet më të fundit dhe më të rëndësishme.

programme.title: Wake Up
programme.desc: Emisioni sjell një kombinim të lajmeve më të rëndësishme të ditës, analizave të aktualitetit, parashikimit të motit, informacioneve praktike, intervistave me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, rubrikave të argëtimit dhe muzikës. Me një atmosferë dinamike dhe pozitive, synon t’i informojë dhe argëtojë teleshikuesit, duke u ofruar energjinë e duhur për nisjen e ditës.

programme.title: Në shtëpinë tonë
programme.desc: Në Shtëpinë Tonë” është emisioni i paradites në Top Channel, një hapësirë e ngrohtë ku bashkohen historia, emocionet, informacioni dhe argëtimi. Me personazhe të njohur e të zakonshëm, rrëfime që frymëzojnë, tema që prekin jetën familjare dhe këshilla praktike për përditshmërinë, programi bëhet pjesë e shtëpisë së çdo teleshikuesi. Në kuzhinë, receta të shijshme dhe ide të thjeshta gatimi sjellin çdo ditë shije dhe kreativitet.

programme.title: Lajme, moti
programme.desc: Lajmet kryesore të ditës nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Shqipëria Live
programme.desc: Programi ku perfshihen te gjitha tematikat kryesore te momentit. Te ftuar te ndryshem, intervista ekskluzive, lidhje direkte dhe debat ne studio. Nje mbulim 360 grade i ngjarjeve ne kohe reale, gjithcka qe ndodh ne vendin tone. Nje nga shtyllat kryesore te programit eshte larmishmeria e perfshirjes te figurave te ndryshme qofte ne studio por edhe nga terreni. Nje program i përditshëm informativ dhe i aktualitetit, i cili sjell në qendër të vëmendjes ngjarjet më të rëndësishme të ditës.

programme.title: Ftesë në Pesë
programme.desc: Programi i pasdites në Top Channel, është një program sa informues aq edhe argëtues që ndërthur intervista, aktualitet, histori njerëzore dhe tema që prekin jetën e përditshme. Me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, personazhe publike dhe njerëz me histori frymëzuese, programi sjell biseda të sinqerta, emocione, debat dhe këndvështrime të ndryshme mbi çështje sociale, kulturore dhe të aktualitetit, në një atmosferë të ngrohtë dhe komunikim të drejtpërdrejtë me publikun.

programme.title: Per’Puthen
programme.desc: Eshtë një program që vendos në qendër njohjet, flirtin dhe marrëdhëniet mes të rinjve që kërkojnë dashurinë. Djem dhe vajza, që njihen me njëri- tjetrin në ekran, për të përmbushur qëllimin e nje dashurie, të ndërtuar në sytë e publikut. Takimet, pëlqimet, xhelozitë, rivalitetet dhe debatet krijojnë dinamika të papritura, ndërsa historitë e personazheve zhvillohen natyrshëm përpara publikut.

programme.title: Lajme, moti
programme.desc: Lajmet kryesore të ditës nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Shqipëria tjetër
programme.desc: Shqipëria Tjetër është një hapsirë për njerëzit e thjeshtë, për njerëzit e pamundur e shpesh të harruar. Në thelb është ajo Shqipëri që ne shpesh kalojmë pa e vënë re dhe na duket fort e largët. Shqipëria tjetër është zëri i të vërtetës, problemeve, i zonave të largëta e të lëna mënjanë.

programme.title: Fiks fare
programme.desc: Programi i pare investigativ ne median shqiptare fokusuar ne korrupsionin e padrejtesite, trafikimin e abuzimet me pushtetin, problemet ekonomike, sociale si dhe hallet e ndryshme te njerezve. Fiks Fare trajton problematikat e qytetarëve, denoncon abuzimet, korrupsionin dhe shkeljet institucionale, duke i sjellë ato në vëmendjen e publikut dhe autoriteteve.

programme.title: Top story
programme.desc: Top Story është programi kryesor i debatit dhe analizës në Top Channel, i cili trajton çështjet më të rëndësishme të aktualitetit politik, ekonomik, social dhe ndërkombëtar. Përmes intervistave ekskluzive, debateve me të ftuar, analizave dhe raportimeve të thelluara, programi ofron një pasqyrë të plotë të zhvillimeve që ndikojnë në jetën publike.

programme.title: Proçesi sportiv
programme.desc: Sporti vjen cdo të hënë në ekranin tuaj me një show të jashtëzakonshem. Proces, analizë, debat, opinion, reagime dhe gjithcka tjetër nga bota e madhe dhe e larmishme e sportit. Por mbi të gjitha, pasqyrimi i evenimenteve sportive brenda dhe jashtë vendit. Të ftuar: specialistët më të mirë, gazetarët më të njohur, të ftuar të ndryshem, rubrika të reja.

programme.desc: Hurt that no one seems to care for his home movies, Ricky declares that he will never show them another feature of his...not even the TV pilot he's creating. Jealous of his project, Lucy enables the help of the Mertzes and creates her own musical western.

Staffel mit 10 Folgen: Bree erfährt, dass ihr Freund Keith einen Sohn hat – ohne etwas davon zu ahnen –, Susan braucht dringend eine neue Niere, Gaby kämpft mit dem Verlust ihrer Tochter, Lynette muss Toms Affäre mit Renee verdauen. \n\nÜbrigens: Alle fünf Hausfrauen haben den Vertrag für die 8. Staffel unterschrieben, die Serie wurde jedoch 2012 nach der 8. Staffel been

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Lynette und Tom haben die Eskapaden ihrer Zwillingssöhne satt. Damit sie selbstständig werden, sollen sie ausziehen. Die Jungs nehmen’s gelassen und nisten sich gegenüber bei Mrs. McCluskey ein. \n\nKeith (Brian Austin Green) möchte seine Vaterrolle erfüllen und plant, zu seinem Sohn nach Florida zu ziehen. Ist das das Aus für ihn und Bree (Marcia Cross)?

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: „Der Sinn des Lebens“. Susans (Teri Hatcher) Nieren drohen schlappzumachen. Bree zettelt deshalb eine Testaktion an, um einen Organspender zu finden. Das Ergebnis ringt ihr eine schwere Entscheidung ab. \n\nGerüchte gab’s lange, nun ist klar: Nach der nächsten Staffel ist Schluss. Schade!

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Besonders Susan, die von Beths Nierenspende erfährt. Doch Ehemann Paul (Mark Moses) steht der geplanten Transplantation im Weg. Er will die Herz-Lungen-Maschine erst abschalten lassen, wenn Beths Mutter ihm den Grund für den Selbstmord nennt. \r\nRenee weigert sich indes, ihre geplante Party zu verschieben. Warum ist sie so herzlos? Gabrielle findet es heraus.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Nach einem Feuer wird eine verkohlte Leiche gefunden: Der Brandexperte war einem Feuerteufel auf der Spur. Als Ryan und Esposito das nächste mögliche Ziel aufsuchen, geraten sie in Lebensgefahr. Derweil steht Lanie (Tamala Jones) Ryans Frau Jenny (Juliana Dever) bei, als die Wehen einsetzen… \n\nDie Emotionen kochen hoch, „Whodunit?“ ist Nebensache.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Der Autor und Polizeiberater Castle sitzt zwischen den Stühlen: Ein Mordfall führt ihn „In geheimer Mission“ erneut zu seinem Vater Jack Hunt (zweiter Gastauftritt für James Brolin, „Hotel“), einem geschassten CIA-Agenten. Als Hunt angeschossen vor seiner Tür steht, gerät Castle vor seiner Verlobten Beckett in Erklärungsnot.

Hatte einer ihrer Verehrer genug von der Vereinbarung?

programme.title: Elementary

programme.desc: Schönheitschirurg Mark Sloan liegt im Koma. Als „Der 30. Tag“ anbricht, sollen die lebensverlängernden Maßnahmen eingestellt werden. Indes versetzt Meredith Grey (Ellen Pompeo) als Stationsärztin die Anfänger in Angst und Schrecken….

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: „Der Sinn des Lebens“. Susans (Teri Hatcher) Nieren drohen schlappzumachen. Bree zettelt deshalb eine Testaktion an, um einen Organspender zu finden. Das Ergebnis ringt ihr eine schwere Entscheidung ab. \n\nGerüchte gab’s lange, nun ist klar: Nach der nächsten Staffel ist Schluss. Schade!

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Besonders Susan, die von Beths Nierenspende erfährt. Doch Ehemann Paul (Mark Moses) steht der geplanten Transplantation im Weg. Er will die Herz-Lungen-Maschine erst abschalten lassen, wenn Beths Mutter ihm den Grund für den Selbstmord nennt. \r\nRenee weigert sich indes, ihre geplante Party zu verschieben. Warum ist sie so herzlos? Gabrielle findet es heraus.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Andrew hatte einst Carlos’ Mutter überfahren – und es vertuscht. Jetzt will er im Rahmen eines Programms der Anonymen Alkoholiker seine Schuld gestehen. \r\nTom (Doug Savant) erhält einen Bonus seiner neuen Firma. Doch Lynette (Felicity Huffman) muss erkennen, dass Toms Job auch Nachteile hat.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Trotz Carlos’ Verbot trifft sich Gabrielle weiterhin mit Bree – heimlich. Als Carlos Indizien für ihr Beisammensein findet, stellt er sie vor die Wahl: Bree oder er? \n\nSusan leidet währenddessen an Sexträumen, in denen ausgerechnet Paul die Hauptrolle spielt. Lynette (Felicity Huffman) begleitet Tom zu einer Konferenz – und verursacht nichts als Ärger.
